pages.title: An invitation
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Are you doing anything on Saturday? There’s a food festival
lines.audioText: Are you doing anything on Saturday? There’s a food festival.
lines.translation: Você vai fazer algo no sábado? Tem um festival de comida

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m going to a yoga class at two. What time is the festival?
lines.audioText: I’m going to a yoga class at two. What time is the festival?
lines.translation: Vou a uma aula de yoga às duas. Que horas é o festival?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It’s open all afternoon, and on Sunday morning too
lines.audioText: It’s open all afternoon, and on Sunday morning too.
lines.translation: Fica aberto a tarde toda e também no domingo de manhã

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Sunday is better for me. I’m free at ten
lines.audioText: Sunday is better for me. I’m free at ten.
lines.translation: Domingo é melhor para mim. Estou livre às dez

questions.prompt: What is Ana doing on Saturday at two?
questions.answer: Ana is going to a yoga class
The festival is open on Saturday afternoon and Sunday morning

questions.prompt: When is Ana free on Sunday?
questions.answer: Ana is free at ten on Sunday

pages.title: Finding a time
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Great! Shall we meet at the entrance?
lines.audioText: Great! Shall we meet at the entrance?
lines.translation: Ótimo! Vamos nos encontrar na entrada?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. I’m going to try something new this time
lines.audioText: Yes. I’m going to try something new this time.
lines.translation: Sim. Desta vez vou experimentar algo novo

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Me too. I’ll check the opening time tonight
lines.audioText: Me too. I’ll check the opening time tonight.
lines.translation: Eu também. Vou conferir o horário de abertura hoje à noite

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Thanks. Send me a message when you know
lines.audioText: Thanks. Send me a message when you know.
lines.translation: Obrigada. Me mande uma mensagem quando souber

pages.title: An arrangement or an intention?
pages.instruction: Connect the meaning, the form and the example

rows.subject: A confirmed arrangement
rows.verb: am / is / are + verb-ing + future time
rows.example: I’m going to a yoga class on Saturday

rows.subject: An intention
rows.verb: am / is / are going to + verb
rows.example: I’m going to try something new

rows.subject: Decline and offer an alternative
rows.verb: I’d love to, but … How about …?
rows.example: I’d love to, but I’m busy. How about Sunday?

pages.title: Find a plan that works
pages.instruction: Invite me to the food festival and find a time that works for both of us

pages.title: The opening time is later
pages.instruction: Listen and answer, then open the video shared in the chat
pages.message: Hi, Ana! I checked the food festival. It opens at eleven on Sunday, not ten. Would eleven thirty work for you? We could meet at the main entrance and have lunch there. I’m still free in the afternoon. If Sunday is difficult, the festival is also open on Saturday until six. What do you think?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! I checked the food festival. It opens at eleven on Sunday, not ten. Would eleven thirty work for you? We could meet at the main entrance and have lunch there. I’m still free in the afternoon. If Sunday is difficult, the festival is also open on Saturday until six. What do you think?
pages.greeting: This clip gave me another idea for making plans
